sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹלֵחַ אָדָם יָרֵךְ לְגוֹי שֶׁגִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה בְּתוֹכָהּ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמְּקוֹמוֹ נִיכָּר.

positions.claim: a Jew may give a gentile a whole thigh containing the sciatic nerve, without concern that a Jew will later buy it and eat the nerve
positions.basis: מפני שמקומו ניכר — the nerve's place is conspicuous, so a Jewish buyer will see that it was not removed
